versions.content: After the reception of a First Frame, if the function PduR_CanTpStartOfReception()returns BUFREQ_E_OVFL to the CanTp module, the CanTp module shall send a Flow Control N - PDU with overflow statu s (FC(OVFLW)) and abort the N - SDU reception.

After the reception of a First Frame, if the function PduR_CanTpStartOfReception()returns BUFREQ_E_OVFL to the CanTp module, the CanTp module shall send a Flow Control N - PDU with overflow statu s (FC(OVFLW)) and abort the N - SDU reception.

After the reception of a First Frame, if the function PduR_- CanTpStartOfReception () returns BUFREQ_E_OVFL to the CanTp module, the Can Tp module shall send a Flow Control N-PDU with overflow status ( FC(OVFLW) ) and abort the N-SDU reception.
